join_rule.within_file_duplicates: SORT by create_time ascending, then keep latest-by-file-order per create_time bucket (early-2021 identical double-writes; conflicting=0 → keep-any equivalent). Some later days are unsorted in-file — sort required.
join_rule.midnight_partition_duplicates: if create_time appears in adjacent day files, keep latest-by-timestamp per bucket (day D+1 row wins only if values differ; else identical). Observed collision stamps tallied below.
join_rule.missing_stamps: Do not invent OI. Forward-fill forbidden for SIGNAL without explicit Edge policy; prefer abstain / NaN feature on missing create_time buckets.

D.create_time_semantics: Exchange observation/snapshot time of the metrics row (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC at 5m steps). Not trade-event time; not funding settlement time.
D.knowability_rule: OI knowable at decision t iff create_time <= t (snapshot_ts ≤ t)
D.oi_aggregation: OI is a LEVEL (last sample in bar), not a sum across trades. Column name sum_open_interest is Binance Vision naming for the OI level.

receipt_publish_lag.note: Vision daily zip first-print / CDN publish time is not recorded in-archive. Zip internal CSV mtimes reflect packaging, not exchange snapshot receipt. Cannot prove zero publish lag beyond create_time itself from this corpus alone.

D.restatement_risk: If Vision re-uploads a day zip (known past metrics repairs), first-print vs restated policy needed; this audit hashes current on-disk bytes only.
D.sub_5m: Native cadence is 5m — shocks inside a bin only visible at bin stamp.

BTCUSDT.stamp_convention_note: create_time stamps fall on the same 5m grid as OHLCV open_time_ms (bucket start). Treat as snapshot time at bar open; for bar [T, T+5m) the level at create_time=T is the OI sample at open. Knowability at decision t requires create_time <= t. For features at bar close, create_time=T is known (T < close).

E.aggregate_rule: Join OI to OHLCV on create_time_ms == open_time_ms (bucket-start convention). OI level for bar open T is the row at create_time=T; do not sum OI. ΔOI features: diff of levels across bars after dedupe.
